goals: Implement a transactional 1:1 counseling booking engine with session pass management
Ensure strict data integrity via business invariants and atomic SQLite transactions
Provide a FIFO waitlist system with automatic promotion upon booking cancellation
Guarantee idempotency for session pass issuance and booking creation
user_flows: Counselor registers and defines available time slots
Client tops up session pass using an idempotency key
Client books an available slot (deducts session)
Client reschedules a booking to a new available slot (atomic swap)
Client joins a waitlist for a booked slot
Client cancels a booking, triggering session restoration and potential waitlist promotion
System performs global reconciliation to verify session and slot counts

business_rules.description: PassLedger.idempotency_key must be unique; duplicate keys return existing state without mutating balances
Promotion occurs in order of insertion; only clients with remaining_sessions >= 1 are eligible
Target slot must be AVAILABLE; old slot must be released or promoted; failure rolls back all changes

edge_cases: Booking attempt when remaining_sessions is exactly 0
Rescheduling a booking to a slot that was just blocked
Cancellation of a booking where the first waitlisted person has 0 sessions
Concurrent booking requests for the same slot (handled by SQLite transaction locks)
Issuing a session pass with a previously used idempotency key
Cancelling a booking that is already in CANCELLED status
design_decisions: Use a single persistent sqlite3.Connection instance to maintain :memory: state across method calls
Wrap all multi-table mutations (Booking, Slot, Pass, Ledger, Audit) in a single transaction block
Use ISO 8601 strings for start_time to ensure consistent sorting and filtering
Implement a 'Saga-like' rollback by utilizing SQLite's atomic COMMIT/ROLLBACK for rescheduling and promotion
Use UUIDs for booking_id to prevent predictable ID enumeration
assumptions: The system operates in a single-process environment where SQLite's default locking is sufficient
Client identity is uniquely determined by client_email
Session pass deduction happens at the moment of booking confirmation (including promotion)
